literature.headline_zh: 麻疹病毒本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期麻疹病毒研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: 在153名受访者中,139名(91%)表示其机构要求某些医疗人员提供麻疹免疫力的证据;20%的机构将其要求应用于特定群体。仅有36%的机构以可访问的电子格式存储雇员的免疫力数据。暴露定义存在差异;33%的受访者使用了可能低估暴露风险的标准(例如,共享空气超过15分钟)。其他机构缺乏获取空气交换数据的途径(33%)。此外,12%至31%的受访者表示其机构不一致地推荐对非免疫个体进行暴露后预防。 [10.1017/ice.2026.10498]
研究发现麻疹病毒多次引入犹他州,其中一次引入占大多数病例。随着麻疹传播,出现了两个系统发育分支,其地理病例构成不同。研究识别出共享学校与基因组聚类之间存在显著关联,并重建了校内传播链及源自校际体育赛事的传播链。 [10.64898/2026.08.25.26361356]
即时预测估计值提高了累计暴发规模估计值的准确性,相比临时数据更为准确,且Rt估计值总体反映了潜在的发病趋势。然而,1月份因临时数据不完整,估计值准确性下降。 [10.15585/mmwr.mm7533a1]
综述得出结论:在中心假设下,仅依靠常规MCV1覆盖在数学上不足以达到群体免疫阈值。然而,高完整两剂系列覆盖率理论上仍有可能达到该阈值,但操作上具有挑战性。监测数据显示与Rcov存在正序地理一致性,表明覆盖率与暴发风险之间可能存在联系。 [10.1016/j.vaccine.2026.129078]

MCV1 的加权 患病率 为 58.3%(95% CI 55.5–61.1%)。观察到显著的空间聚类(全局莫兰指数 I = 0.653,p < 0.001),在北部地区(Togdheer、Sool、Sanaag 及 Bari)发现显著热点,而在南部地区(Gedo、Lower Juba 及 Bakool)发现冷点。多层次分析显示,儿童年龄(48–59 个月的校正优势比 AOR = 16.32)、母亲受过中等教育(AOR = 1.83)、中等收入家庭(AOR = 1.88)及游牧居住(AOR = 1.60)是 疫苗接种 的显著预测因子。 [10.1007/s44155-026-00416-4]
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: 本期研究方向以入选文献实际覆盖的临床、流行病学、宿主生态、诊断或分子监测主题为准。
literature.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments.
key_findings_en: Of 153 respondents, 139 (91%) reported that their institutions required evidence of measles immunity for some healthcare personnel; 20% applied this requirement to a subset. Only 36% of facilities stored immunity data for employed staff in accessible electronic format. [10.1017/ice.2026.10498]

We found multiple introductions of measles into Utah, with one accounting for the majority of cases. As measles spread, two phylogenetic clades emerged with differing geographical case compositions. [10.64898/2026.08.25.26361356]

The authors reported that measles has a high transmissibility rate (R 0 of 12-18) and can spread rapidly among susceptible individuals. They highlighted the need for improved surveillance systems to detect and respond to outbreaks effectively. [10.1111/tmi.70220]

Nowcast estimates improved the accuracy of cumulative outbreak size compared with provisional data, and Rt estimates generally reflected underlying transmission trends. However, accuracy declined in January due to less complete provisional data. [10.15585/mmwr.mm7533a1]

The review concludes that routine MCV1 coverage alone is mathematically insufficient to reach the population-immunity threshold under the central assumptions. However, high complete two-dose-series coverage remains theoretically capable of achieving the threshold, though it is operationally demanding. [10.1016/j.vaccine.2026.129078]
literature.trend_or_risk_en: The direction of this week's research is defined by the clinical, epidemiological, ecological, diagnostic and molecular topics actually represented by the eligible publications.

papers.title: Measles outbreak risk in Afghanistan: provincial immunity gaps and epidemic potential following immunisation system disruption
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Following the 2021 political transition, Afghanistan's routine immunisation system experienced disruption. The 2022-23 Afghanistan Multiple Indicator Cluster Survey (MICS) estimated national first-dose measles-containing vaccine (MCV1) coverage at 51.2% (95% CI 49.1-53.2). Provincial heterogeneity in coverage-derived measles transmission potential has not been quantified using these household survey data. METHODS: Provincial MCV1 coverage among children aged 12-23 months was obtained from the 2022-23 MICS (unweighted n = 6177; weighted n = 6383). We calculated a coverage-adjusted transmission-potential index, Rcov = R0 × (1 - MCV1 × VE1), using R0 = 15 and one-dose vaccine effectiveness (VE1) = 0.93. Deterministic SEIR scenarios and complementary stochastic tau-leaping simulations were run using an 8-day mean latent period and 4-day infectious-compartment duration. Survey uncertainty, upper-bound routine-MCV1 protection gaps, and preferential- and random-targeting SIA requirements were quantified. RESULTS: Provincial MCV1 coverage ranged from 8.6% to 88.7%, and all 34 provinces had Rcov > 1 (range 2.63-13.80; U5-weighted aggregate 7.95). The theoretical one-dose coverage requirement was 100.36%, whereas the requirement for a complete two-dose series using empirical VE2 = 0.97 was 96.22%. The standardized 3.5-year upper-bound accumulation of children remaining unprotected by routine MCV1 was 3.02 million (conditional 95% interval 2.92-3.12 million). The province-summed SIA requirement was 4.06 million children (49.8% of U5) under idealized preferential targeting and 7.53 million (92.4%) under random targeting. Single-importation establishment probability ranged from 65.9% to 93.9% across nine illustrative provinces. WHO week-14 surveillance showed positive ordinal geographic concordance with Rcov (Kendall τb = 0.331; Spearman ρ = 0.430; both p = 0.011). CONCLUSIONS: Routine MCV1 alone is mathematically insufficient to reach the population-immunity threshold under the central assumptions. High complete two-dose-series coverage remains theoretically capable of reaching the threshold but is operationally demanding. Sustained routine two-dose delivery, high-reach SIAs, and restoration of immunisation-system capacity are likely to be required. The surveillance comparison is retrospective and supports geographic concordance rather than external model validation.

papers.title_original: Measles outbreak risk in Afghanistan: provincial immunity gaps and epidemic potential following immunisation system disruption

analysis.scope_and_question: The review focuses on measles outbreak risk in Afghanistan following the disruption of the immunisation system after the 2021 political transition. The central question is whether routine measles-containing vaccine (MCV1) coverage alone is sufficient to prevent outbreaks, and what additional measures are required to achieve population immunity.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The evidence base includes the 2022-23 Afghanistan Multiple Indicator Cluster Survey (MICS) data, which provided provincial MCV1 coverage estimates. The review used deterministic SEIR scenarios and stochastic tau-leaping simulations to model measles transmission potential. The coverage-adjusted transmission-potential index, Rcov, was calculated using R0 = 15 and one-dose vaccine effectiveness (VE1) = 0.93. The study also quantified survey uncertainty, upper-bound routine-MCV1 protection gaps, and the requirements for supplementary immunisation activities (SIAs) under preferential and random targeting.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review concludes that routine MCV1 coverage alone is mathematically insufficient to reach the population-immunity threshold under the central assumptions. However, high complete two-dose-series coverage remains theoretically capable of achieving the threshold, though it is operationally demanding. The surveillance data showed positive ordinal geographic concordance with Rcov, indicating a potential link between coverage and outbreak risk.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review notes that provincial heterogeneity in coverage-derived measles transmission potential has not been quantified using the household survey data. Additionally, the surveillance comparison is retrospective and supports geographic concordance rather than external model validation. There is also a lack of data on the long-term impact of immunisation system disruption and the effectiveness of SIAs in different contexts.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review highlights the need for sustained routine two-dose delivery, high-reach SIAs, and the restoration of immunisation-system capacity to mitigate measles outbreak risk. It also suggests that further research is required to quantify provincial heterogeneity in transmission potential and to evaluate the effectiveness of SIAs under various targeting strategies.

analysis.summary_en: This review examines measles outbreak risk in Afghanistan following the disruption of the immunisation system after the 2021 political transition. It uses data from the 2022-23 MICS survey to estimate provincial measles-containing vaccine (MCV1) coverage and models measles transmission potential using Rcov = R0 × (1 - MCV1 × VE1). The results show that routine MCV1 coverage alone is insufficient to reach the population-immunity threshold, but high complete two-dose-series coverage could be effective. The study also highlights the need for high-reach supplementary immunisation activities (SIAs) and the restoration of immunisation-system capacity. The surveillance data showed geographic concordance with Rcov, but the comparison was retrospective and did not validate the model externally. The review identifies provincial heterogeneity in coverage and transmission potential as a key evidence gap, emphasizing the need for further research and targeted interventions.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 本综述聚焦于2021年政治过渡后阿富汗免疫系统中断所导致的麻疹 暴发风险。核心问题是:常规麻疹含疫苗(MCV1)覆盖是否足以防止暴发,以及还需要哪些额外措施才能实现群体免疫。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 证据基础包括2022-23年阿富汗多重指标簇调查(MICS)数据,提供了各省份MCV1覆盖率的估计。综述采用确定性SEIR情景模拟和随机tau跳跃模拟来建模麻疹 传播潜在风险。使用R0=15和单剂疫苗效果(VE1)=0.93计算了覆盖率调整的传播潜在指数Rcov。研究还量化了调查不确定性、常规MCV1保护缺口上限以及在优先和随机目标策略下的补充免疫活动(SIA)需求。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 综述得出结论:在中心假设下,仅依靠常规MCV1覆盖在数学上不足以达到群体免疫阈值。然而,高完整两剂系列覆盖率理论上仍有可能达到该阈值,但操作上具有挑战性。监测数据显示与Rcov存在正序地理一致性,表明覆盖率与暴发风险之间可能存在联系。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 综述指出,尚未利用家庭调查数据量化省际覆盖率衍生的麻疹 传播潜在风险。此外,监测比较是回顾性的,支持地理一致性而非外部模型验证。还缺乏关于免疫系统中断长期影响以及不同情境下SIA效果的数据。

analysis_en.scope_and_question: The review focuses on measles outbreak risk in Afghanistan following the disruption of the immunisation system after the 2021 political transition. The central question is whether routine measles-containing vaccine (MCV1) coverage alone is sufficient to prevent outbreaks, and what additional measures are required to achieve population immunity.
analysis_en.evidence_base_and_review_method: The evidence base includes the 2022-23 Afghanistan Multiple Indicator Cluster Survey (MICS) data, which provided provincial MCV1 coverage estimates. The review used deterministic SEIR scenarios and stochastic tau-leaping simulations to model measles transmission potential. The coverage-adjusted transmission-potential index, Rcov, was calculated using R0 = 15 and one-dose vaccine effectiveness (VE1) = 0.93. The study also quantified survey uncertainty, upper-bound routine-MCV1 protection gaps, and the requirements for supplementary immunisation activities (SIAs) under preferential and random targeting.
analysis_en.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review concludes that routine MCV1 coverage alone is mathematically insufficient to reach the population-immunity threshold under the central assumptions. However, high complete two-dose-series coverage remains theoretically capable of achieving the threshold, though it is operationally demanding. The surveillance data showed positive ordinal geographic concordance with Rcov, indicating a potential link between coverage and outbreak risk.
analysis_en.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review notes that provincial heterogeneity in coverage-derived measles transmission potential has not been quantified using the household survey data. Additionally, the surveillance comparison is retrospective and supports geographic concordance rather than external model validation. There is also a lack of data on the long-term impact of immunisation system disruption and the effectiveness of SIAs in different contexts.
analysis_en.research_and_practice_implications: The review highlights the need for sustained routine two-dose delivery, high-reach SIAs, and the restoration of immunisation-system capacity to mitigate measles outbreak risk. It also suggests that further research is required to quantify provincial heterogeneity in transmission potential and to evaluate the effectiveness of SIAs under various targeting strategies.

papers.title_zh: 阿富汗麻疹风险:免疫系统中断后的省际免疫缺口与疫情潜在风险
papers.source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Following the 2021 political transition, Afghanistan's routine immunisation system experienced disruption. The 2022-23 Afghanistan Multiple Indicator Cluster Survey (MICS) estimated national first-dose measles-containing vaccine (MCV1) coverage at 51.2% (95% CI 49.1-53.2). Provincial heterogeneity in coverage-derived measles transmission potential has not been quantified using these household survey data. METHODS: Provincial MCV1 coverage among children aged 12-23 months was obtained from the 2022-23 MICS (unweighted n = 6177; weighted n = 6383). We calculated a coverage-adjusted transmission-potential index, Rcov = R0 × (1 - MCV1 × VE1), using R0 = 15 and one-dose vaccine effectiveness (VE1) = 0.93. Deterministic SEIR scenarios and complementary stochastic tau-leaping simulations were run using an 8-day mean latent period and 4-day infectious-compartment duration. Survey uncertainty, upper-bound routine-MCV1 protection gaps, and preferential- and random-targeting SIA requirements were quantified. RESULTS: Provincial MCV1 coverage ranged from 8.6% to 88.7%, and all 34 provinces had Rcov > 1 (range 2.63-13.80; U5-weighted aggregate 7.95). The theoretical one-dose coverage requirement was 100.36%, whereas the requirement for a complete two-dose series using empirical VE2 = 0.97 was 96.22%. The standardized 3.5-year upper-bound accumulation of children remaining unprotected by routine MCV1 was 3.02 million (conditional 95% interval 2.92-3.12 million). The province-summed SIA requirement was 4.06 million children (49.8% of U5) under idealized preferential targeting and 7.53 million (92.4%) under random targeting. Single-importation establishment probability ranged from 65.9% to 93.9% across nine illustrative provinces. WHO week-14 surveillance showed positive ordinal geographic concordance with Rcov (Kendall τb = 0.331; Spearman ρ = 0.430; both p = 0.011). CONCLUSIONS: Routine MCV1 alone is mathematically insufficient to reach the population-immunity threshold under the central assumptions. High complete two-dose-series coverage remains theoretically capable of reaching the threshold but is operationally demanding. Sustained routine two-dose delivery, high-reach SIAs, and restoration of immunisation-system capacity are likely to be required. The surveillance comparison is retrospective and supports geographic concordance rather than external model validation.

papers.title: Measles Frontline Defense: The Pivotal Role of Emergency Nurses and Emergency Medical Services Personnel
papers.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Measles was declared eliminated in the United States in 2000. However, in 2025, the country experienced the highest number of cases reported in more than 2 decades. Furthermore, early 2026 data from the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention indicate a continued increase in case counts. Emergency nurses and emergency medical technicians frequently serve as the initial health care professionals who assess patients with fever and rashes. Prompt identification and swift isolation are essential to curtail measles transmission. This narrative literature review aims to provide practical, evidence-based guidance for emergency nurses and emergency medical technicians on the recognition, isolation, documentation, infection control, and coordination with public health authorities during measles outbreaks. METHODS: A narrative review synthesizing current Centers for Disease Control and Prevention and World Health Organization guidance was conducted. Peer-reviewed literature was identified through targeted searches in PubMed and Google Scholar using keywords, including measles, emergency department, prehospital, emergency nurse, emergency medical services, triage, and infection control, focusing on publications from 2015 to 2026. Studies providing practical guidance or epidemiologic data relevant to emergency medical settings were prioritized. RESULTS: Measles spreads through airborne transmission and can remain suspended in the air for up to 2 hours after an infected individual leaves an area. Early symptoms include fever, cough, coryza (runny nose and nasal congestion), and conjunctivitis, followed by a descending maculopapular rash (red rash with both flat areas and small bumps on the skin), which typically begins on the face and spreads downward. Proper triage assessment, infection-control measures, documentation within electronic health records, and timely communication with infection prevention and public health authorities are essential to interrupt the transmission. DISCUSSION: Measles remains one of the most contagious viral illnesses encountered in health care settings. Emergency nurses and emergency medical technicians are often the first to recognize and halt the spread of measles. Clear triage and screening steps should be used, staff immunity should be confirmed, and close collaboration with infection prevention and public health teams is necessary to protect patients, families, and health care workers.

analysis.summary_en: Measles, declared eliminated in the United States in 2000 (A1), has re‐emerged with the highest case count in over 20 years (A2) and continues to rise in early 2026 (A3). The virus spreads via airborne transmission that can persist for up to two hours (A10) and presents with fever, cough, coryza, conjunctivitis, and a descending maculopapular rash (A11). Emergency nurses and emergency medical technicians are often the first to encounter these signs (A4) and must promptly identify, isolate, and implement infection‐control measures to curb spread (A5, A12). A narrative literature review synthesizing CDC and WHO guidance (A7) searched PubMed and Google Scholar for 2015‐2026 publications on measles in emergency settings (A8) and prioritized practical guidance (A9). Consensus emphasizes that early triage, isolation, documentation, staff immunity verification, and coordinated communication with public‐health authorities are essential to interrupt transmission (A12, A13, A14, A15). Evidence gaps include limited data on optimal emergency triage and surveillance strategies despite the ongoing increase in cases (A2, A3, A15). Future priorities focus on developing and validating emergency‐department triage algorithms, ensuring staff immunity, strengthening infection‐control practices, and enhancing real‐time surveillance to protect patients, families, and health‐care workers.

papers.title: Measles prevention and control in the acute healthcare setting—minding the gaps
papers.abstract: Abstract Background: As measles vaccination rates in the United States decline and incidence rises, healthcare facilities face an increased risk of measles transmission. Measles exposures in clinical settings lead to extensive contact tracing investigations, significant staffing disruptions, high costs, and potential infections in vulnerable patients. This study aimed to assess US hospitals’ readiness of to identify and manage measles exposures and to identify common infection prevention gaps. Methods: In 2025, the Emerging Infections Network (EIN) conducted a 9-question electronic survey of its physician members. The questions addressed immunization policies, exposure identification capabilities, and management protocols. Results: Of 153 respondents whose scope of practice includes measles prevention, 139 (91%) reported that their institutions required evidence of measles immunity for some healthcare personnel; 20% applied this requirement to a subset. Only 36% of facilities stored immunity data for employed staff in accessible electronic format. Most facilities could determine when patients were in specific clinical areas but could not identify visitors or non-employed staff. Exposure definitions varied; 33% of respondents used criteria that potentially underestimate exposure risk (eg, >15 min of shared air). Others lacked access to air exchange data (33%). Furthermore, 12%–31% of respondents reported their institutions do not consistently recommend postexposure prophylaxis for non-immune individuals. Conclusions: Despite the high transmissibility of measles, significant gaps in record-keeping, exposure definitions, and prophylaxis protocols persist in US hospitals. Standardized exposure criteria and improved accessibility to staff immunity records could help reduce measles transmission in health care and the associated clinical and financial adverse outcomes.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 随着美国麻疹 疫苗接种发病率下降而发病率上升,医疗机构面临更高的麻疹 传播风险。本研究旨在评估美国医院识别和管理麻疹暴露的准备情况,并找出常见的感染预防差距。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 2025年,新兴感染网络(EIN)对其医生成员进行了9个问题的电子问卷调查。在153名受访者中,其执业范围包括麻疹预防,其中139名(91%)表示其机构要求某些医疗人员提供麻疹免疫力的证据;20%的机构将其要求应用于特定群体。
elements_zh.methods: 本研究采用电子问卷评估免疫接种政策、暴露识别能力和管理协议。问题涉及麻疹预防实践,包括对免疫力记录的要求和暴露定义。
elements_zh.main_results: 在153名受访者中,139名(91%)表示其机构要求某些医疗人员提供麻疹免疫力的证据;20%的机构将其要求应用于特定群体。仅有36%的机构以可访问的电子格式存储雇员的免疫力数据。暴露定义存在差异;33%的受访者使用了可能低估暴露风险的标准(例如,共享空气超过15分钟)。其他机构缺乏获取空气交换数据的途径(33%)。此外,12%至31%的受访者表示其机构不一致地推荐对非免疫个体进行暴露后预防。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者认为,尽管麻疹具有高度传染性,但美国医院在记录保存、暴露定义和预防协议方面仍存在显著差距。本研究强调了制定标准化暴露标准以及改善对员工免疫力记录的可访问性的必要性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为改善医疗环境中麻疹的预防与控制提供依据,通过解决免疫力记录、暴露定义和暴露后预防协议方面的差距。这些改进有助于减少麻疹 传播及其相关的临床和财务不良后果。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性在于依赖于医生成员的自我报告数据,这可能引入偏差。由于回答可能存在差异且缺乏直接的观察数据,证据强度中等。

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景:随着美国麻疹 疫苗接种发病率下降而发病率上升,医疗机构面临更高的麻疹 传播风险。在临床环境中发生麻疹暴露会导致广泛的接触追踪调查、显著的人力资源中断、高昂的成本以及易感患者潜在感染。本研究旨在评估美国医院识别和管理麻疹暴露的准备情况,并找出常见的感染预防差距。方法:2025年,新兴感染网络(EIN)对其医生成员进行了9个问题的电子问卷调查。问题涉及免疫接种政策、暴露识别能力以及管理协议。结果:在153名受访者中,其执业范围包括麻疹预防,其中139名(91%)表示其机构要求某些医疗人员提供麻疹免疫力的证据;20%的机构将其要求应用于特定群体。仅有36%的机构以可访问的电子格式存储雇员的免疫力数据。大多数机构能够确定患者是否处于特定临床区域,但无法识别访客或非雇员人员。暴露定义存在差异;33%的受访者使用了可能低估暴露风险的标准(例如,共享空气超过15分钟)。其他机构缺乏获取空气交换数据的途径(33%)。此外,12%至31%的受访者表示其机构不一致地推荐对非免疫个体进行暴露后预防。结论:尽管麻疹具有高度传染性,但美国医院在记录保存、暴露定义和预防协议方面仍存在显著差距。标准化的暴露标准以及改善对员工免疫力记录的可访问性有助于减少医疗环境中麻疹 传播及其相关的临床和财务不良后果。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 随着美国麻疹 疫苗接种发病率下降而发病率上升,医疗机构面临更高的麻疹 传播风险。本研究旨在评估美国医院识别和管理麻疹暴露的准备情况,并找出常见的感染预防差距。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 2025年,新兴感染网络(EIN)对其医生成员进行了9个问题的电子问卷调查。在153名受访者中,其执业范围包括麻疹预防,其中139名(91%)表示其机构要求某些医疗人员提供麻疹免疫力的证据;20%的机构将其要求应用于特定群体。
analysis_zh.methods: 本研究采用电子问卷评估免疫接种政策、暴露识别能力和管理协议。问题涉及麻疹预防实践,包括对免疫力记录的要求和暴露定义。
analysis_zh.main_results: 在153名受访者中,139名(91%)表示其机构要求某些医疗人员提供麻疹免疫力的证据;20%的机构将其要求应用于特定群体。仅有36%的机构以可访问的电子格式存储雇员的免疫力数据。暴露定义存在差异;33%的受访者使用了可能低估暴露风险的标准(例如,共享空气超过15分钟)。其他机构缺乏获取空气交换数据的途径(33%)。此外,12%至31%的受访者表示其机构不一致地推荐对非免疫个体进行暴露后预防。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者认为,尽管麻疹具有高度传染性,但美国医院在记录保存、暴露定义和预防协议方面仍存在显著差距。本研究强调了制定标准化暴露标准以及改善对员工免疫力记录的可访问性的必要性。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为改善医疗环境中麻疹的预防与控制提供依据,通过解决免疫力记录、暴露定义和暴露后预防协议方面的差距。这些改进有助于减少麻疹 传播及其相关的临床和财务不良后果。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性在于依赖于医生成员的自我报告数据,这可能引入偏差。由于回答可能存在差异且缺乏直接的观察数据,证据强度中等。

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to address the gaps in measles molecular epidemiology by evaluating the effectiveness of tiered genomic surveillance in identifying factors contributing to measles outbreaks, particularly in Bangladesh. The authors emphasized that measles elimination requires robust surveillance systems, prompt outbreak detection, and rapid public health interventions.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study focused on measles outbreaks in Bangladesh, analyzing the role of genomic surveillance in monitoring disease trends and identifying transmission patterns. It included data from recent outbreaks and highlighted the importance of surveillance in supporting measles elimination goals.
analysis.methods: The authors reviewed measles outbreak data and utilized genomic surveillance techniques to monitor disease trends and transmission patterns. They analyzed the factors contributing to the outbreaks and discussed the role of surveillance in public health interventions.
analysis.main_results: The authors reported that measles has a high transmissibility rate (R 0 of 12-18) and can spread rapidly among susceptible individuals. They highlighted the need for improved surveillance systems to detect and respond to outbreaks effectively.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted their findings as evidence that tiered genomic surveillance can enhance the understanding of measles transmission dynamics and support elimination efforts. They emphasized the novelty of integrating surveillance with outbreak response strategies.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that genomic surveillance can inform more targeted public health interventions and improve outbreak detection, which is critical for measles elimination. They also highlight the importance of monitoring disease trends to prevent rapid spread in susceptible populations.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The supplied evidence does not report specific limitations of the study, but the findings are based on a review of outbreak data and are presented as a general commentary rather than a detailed analysis. The evidence strength is moderate due to the lack of specific statistical or methodological details.

analysis.summary_en: This study addresses the gaps in measles molecular epidemiology by examining the role of tiered genomic surveillance in outbreak detection and response. The authors highlight the high transmissibility of measles (R 0 of 12-18) and emphasize the need for robust surveillance systems to support elimination goals. They argue that monitoring disease trends and transmission patterns is essential for effective public health interventions. The study is based on a review of outbreak data and is presented as a general commentary, which limits the strength of the evidence. The findings suggest that genomic surveillance can improve understanding of measles dynamics and inform targeted strategies for prevention and control.

papers.title: Robust measles vaccine allocation in US schools requires hedging against unmeasured introduction risk
papers.abstract: Abstract The United States is on the verge of losing measles elimination status, and the doses that could prevent it are already committed; what is still open is which schools get them first. Allocation theory answers that by ordering schools on marginal herd-immunity return rather than lowest coverage, and across 36,031 US schools the theorem’s binding case is the common one: two thirds to three quarters of susceptible kindergarteners attend schools where each added dose buys increasing herd immunity. That ordering returns 1.92 times the indirect protection of lowest-coverage-first, or 1.16 times the total protection. But it assumes every school is equally likely to see a case. Pre-outbreak records from the 2025-26 Upstate South Carolina outbreak are inconsistent with that premise: exposed schools are over-represented 5.0-fold in the top decile of susceptible headcount (95% CI 3.0 to 7.3), while enrollment, a negative control carrying school size but not susceptibility, shows none. An independent outbreak in Clark County, Washington reproduces the scaling, but only two US jurisdictions publish records permitting this test, so how steeply risk scales is unidentified nationally. Under that uncertainty the theoretically optimal rule is the least robust of seven we evaluate, losing 86% of attainable benefit in its worst case, and that fragility holds however the uncertainty set is drawn. A light hedge on measured risk holds roughly 90% at the primary budget, computed from the two columns states already publish. Wherever targeting is optimized on a well-measured variable while exposure risk goes unmeasured, the point-estimate optimum is the fragile choice.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study addresses the need for robust measles vaccine allocation in US schools to prevent the loss of measles elimination status, focusing on the question of which schools should receive vaccines first to maximize herd immunity.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study evaluates vaccine allocation strategies across 36,031 US schools, considering the measles elimination status and the potential impact of vaccine distribution on herd immunity, particularly in schools with high numbers of susceptible kindergarteners.
analysis.methods: The methods involve applying allocation theory to order schools based on marginal herd-immunity return, using pre-outbreak records from specific outbreaks to assess the relationship between school susceptibility and outbreak risk.
analysis.main_results: The results indicate that ordering schools by marginal herd-immunity return yields 1.92 times the indirect protection compared to lowest-coverage-first, and 1.16 times the total protection. However, the assumption that all schools are equally likely to see a case is challenged by outbreak data showing a 5.0-fold over-representation of schools with high susceptible headcounts.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret that the theoretically optimal allocation rule is fragile under uncertainty about risk scaling, and that a light hedge on measured risk retains about 90% of the primary budget's benefit. This highlights the importance of considering unmeasured introduction risk in vaccine allocation strategies.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings inform the need for more accurate risk assessment in measles vaccine allocation, emphasizing the value of targeting schools with higher susceptibility while accounting for unmeasured introduction risks to improve public health outcomes.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence is limited by the lack of national data on risk scaling, as only two jurisdictions publish records permitting this test. This results in moderate confidence in the findings, as the fragility of the optimal rule remains under uncertainty.

analysis.summary_en: This study examines the optimal strategy for measles vaccine allocation in US schools to prevent the loss of elimination status. It highlights that ordering schools by marginal herd-immunity return, rather than lowest coverage, provides greater protection. However, the assumption of equal risk across schools is challenged by outbreak data showing a significant over-representation of high-susceptibility schools. The authors emphasize the fragility of the theoretically optimal rule under uncertainty about risk scaling and suggest a light hedge on measured risk as a more robust approach. The findings underscore the importance of accurate risk assessment in vaccine distribution strategies for public health. The study's limitations include the lack of national data on risk scaling, which restricts the generalizability of the results. The evidence is moderate in strength due to these constraints.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究在36,031所美国学校中评估疫苗分配策略,考虑麻疹消除状态及疫苗分配对群体免疫的潜在影响,特别关注易感幼儿园儿童数量较多的学校。

papers.title: Use of Nowcasting to Estimate Real-Time Transmission Trends During a Measles Outbreak — South Carolina, October 2025–March 2026
papers.abstract: During October 2025-March 2026, South Carolina experienced the largest measles outbreak in the United States in approximately 30 years, with 997 cases reported. The South Carolina Department of Public Health reported confirmed measles cases to CDC through regular updates of provisional (initially reported) line-list data, including essential date fields for each case (rash onset and public health report dates). As in all disease surveillance systems, because provisional data are subject to reporting delays, determining current transmission trends is challenging. CDC developed a nowcasting estimation model to generate real-time estimates that correct for reporting delays. Real-time estimates were generated for the final case counts and time-varying effective reproduction number (Rt), an indicator of whether the rate of new infections is increasing or decreasing. Whether case reporting during an active measles outbreak would be stable enough to support accurate real-time nowcasting was unknown before the data in this report were analyzed. During this outbreak, nowcasts improved estimates of cumulative outbreak size compared with provisional data, and Rt estimates generally captured underlying transmission trends. Nowcast estimates of daily cases were generally accurate, although accuracy declined in January when provisional data were less complete than expected because of a rapid increase in cases. These results demonstrate that if essential date fields are consistently collected, nowcasting can support situational awareness and decisions about response capacity by providing real-time estimates of daily case counts and transmission trends.
papers.journal: MMWR. Morbidity and Mortality Weekly Report

analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results can inform public health surveillance systems by providing real-time estimates of measles transmission trends, aiding in the timely allocation of response resources.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's reliance on provisional data introduces potential biases, and the accuracy of nowcasting declined during periods of data incompleteness, suggesting moderate confidence in the estimates.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluated the use of nowcasting to estimate real-time measles transmission trends during a large outbreak in South Carolina from October 2025 to March 2026. The South Carolina Department of Public Health reported confirmed measles cases to CDC through provisional line-list data, which included essential date fields for each case. CDC developed a nowcasting model to generate real-time estimates of daily case counts and the effective reproduction number (Rt), correcting for reporting delays. Nowcast estimates improved the accuracy of cumulative outbreak size compared with provisional data, and Rt estimates generally captured underlying transmission trends. However, accuracy declined in January due to less complete provisional data. The study demonstrated that consistent collection of essential date fields can support real-time nowcasting, enhancing situational awareness during measles outbreaks. These results have implications for public health surveillance systems, enabling more timely allocation of response resources. The study's reliance on provisional data introduces potential biases, and the accuracy of nowcasting declined during periods of data incompleteness, suggesting moderate confidence in the estimates.

papers.abstract_zh: 2025年10月至2026年3月,南卡罗来纳州经历了美国约30年来规模最大的麻疹暴发,报告病例997例。南卡罗来纳州公共卫生部门通过定期更新临时(初始报告)个案名单数据,向美国疾病控制与预防中心(CDC)报告确诊麻疹病例,其中包含每例病例的关键日期字段(皮疹出现日期和公共卫生报告日期)。与所有疾病监测系统相同,由于临时数据存在报告延迟,确定当前发病趋势具有挑战性。CDC开发了一种即时预测估计模型,用于生成实时估计值以校正报告延迟。实时估计值用于最终病例数及时变有效繁殖数(Rt),后者是判断新发感染率是上升还是下降的指标。在本报告数据分析前,尚不清楚在活跃的麻疹暴发期间,病例报告是否足够稳定以支持准确的实时即时预测。在此次暴发期间,即时预测法改善了累计暴发规模估计值,相比临时数据更为准确,且Rt估计值总体上捕捉到了潜在的发病趋势。每日病例的即时预测估计值总体准确,但在1月份因临时数据因病例激增而不完整,准确性有所下降。这些结果表明,若能持续收集关键日期字段,即时预测法可通过提供每日病例数和发病趋势的实时估计值,支持疫情态势感知与响应能力决策。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在评估实时即时预测法是否能在暴发期间提供准确的麻疹发病趋势估计值,以应对疾病监测系统中的报告延迟挑战。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究分析了南卡罗来纳州于2025年10月至2026年3月期间的麻疹暴发数据,重点关注通过临时个案名单数据向CDC报告的确诊病例,其中包含每例病例的关键日期字段。
analysis_zh.methods: CDC开发了一种即时预测估计模型,用于生成每日病例数和有效繁殖数(Rt)的实时估计值,通过纳入临时数据更新校正报告延迟。
analysis_zh.main_results: 即时预测估计值提高了累计暴发规模估计值的准确性,相比临时数据更为准确,且Rt估计值总体反映了潜在的发病趋势。然而,1月份因临时数据不完整,估计值准确性下降。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,持续收集关键日期字段可支持实时即时预测,为暴发期间提升疫情态势感知提供了一种新颖方法。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果可为公共卫生监测系统提供实时估计麻疹发病趋势的依据,协助及时调配响应资源。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究依赖临时数据可能引入潜在偏倚,且在数据不完整期间即时预测准确性下降,表明对估计值的信心为中等。

papers.title: Timeliness of measles vaccination in selected districts of Oromia Region, Ethiopia – 2021
papers.abstract: Background Delays in vaccination with the first/s dose of measles-containing vaccine (MCV1, MCV2) increases risk of measles transmission. MCV2 was added to Ethiopia's routine immunization schedule in 2019, administered at age 15 months. We describe age at measles vaccination and characteristics associated with timely vaccination following MCV2 introduction. Methods A secondary analysis from a 2021 cross-sectional household survey of children aged 12–35 months in Oromia, Ethiopia was conducted. MCV vaccination status and age at vaccination were determined from the child's vaccination card. The cumulative card-confirmed vaccination coverage of MCV1 and MCV2 (among children 24–35 months) by age at vaccination was estimated. Among children who received MCV, vaccination timing was classified as early (MCV1: <9 months; MCV2: <15 months), timely (MCV1: 9 to <10 months; MCV2: 15 to <16 months), or delayed (MCV1: ≥10 months; MCV2: ≥16 months). Characteristics associated with timely MCV1 vaccination were analyzed using multivariate logistic regression, with urban/rural stratification. Results Overall, 651 children aged 12–35 months (MCV1) and a subset of 270 children aged 24–35 months (MCV2) were analyzed. Cumulative MCV1 coverage was 59.9% by age 9 months and 76.3% by age 12 months, and MCV2 was 33.0% by age 15 months and 44.8% by age 24 months. MCV coverage was generally higher in urban compared to rural areas. Among vaccinated children, the proportion receiving early, timely, and delayed doses was 30.1%, 44.5%, and 25.3% for MCV1, and 28.6%, 41.2%, and 30.3% for MCV2, respectively. Characteristics associated with timely MCV1 vaccination differed in urban and rural areas, but common themes included increased caregiver immunization awareness and service delivery aspects. Conclusions Although most children who received MCV1 were vaccinated by 12 months, many received delayed doses. MCV2 coverage was low, irrespective of vaccination timing. Findings highlight the importance of routine catch-up vaccination policies and guidance, and the need for tailored strategies in urban and rural settings to improve MCV coverage and timely vaccination.

analysis.summary_en: This study examines the timeliness of measles vaccination in Oromia Region, Ethiopia, following the introduction of MCV2 in 2019. A secondary analysis of a 2021 cross-sectional household survey of children aged 12–35 months was conducted. The study found that MCV1 coverage was 59.9% by age 9 months and 76.3% by age 12 months, while MCV2 coverage was 33.0% by age 15 months and 44.8% by age 24 months. MCV coverage was higher in urban areas compared to rural areas. The characteristics associated with timely MCV1 vaccination varied between urban and rural settings, but common factors included caregiver awareness and service delivery aspects. The study emphasizes the need for catch-up vaccination policies and tailored strategies to improve measles vaccine coverage and timeliness. The evidence is moderate in strength due to the absence of reported limitations.

papers.title_zh: 麻疹 疫苗接种 在埃塞俄比亚奥罗米亚地区选定地区的及时性 – 2021
papers.source_body_en: Background Delays in vaccination with the first/s dose of measles-containing vaccine (MCV1, MCV2) increases risk of measles transmission. MCV2 was added to Ethiopia's routine immunization schedule in 2019, administered at age 15 months. We describe age at measles vaccination and characteristics associated with timely vaccination following MCV2 introduction. Methods A secondary analysis from a 2021 cross-sectional household survey of children aged 12–35 months in Oromia, Ethiopia was conducted. MCV vaccination status and age at vaccination were determined from the child's vaccination card. The cumulative card-confirmed vaccination coverage of MCV1 and MCV2 (among children 24–35 months) by age at vaccination was estimated. Among children who received MCV, vaccination timing was classified as early (MCV1: <9 months; MCV2: <15 months), timely (MCV1: 9 to <10 months; MCV2: 15 to <16 months), or delayed (MCV1: ≥10 months; MCV2: ≥16 months). Characteristics associated with timely MCV1 vaccination were analyzed using multivariate logistic regression, with urban/rural stratification. Results Overall, 651 children aged 12–35 months (MCV1) and a subset of 270 children aged 24–35 months (MCV2) were analyzed. Cumulative MCV1 coverage was 59.9% by age 9 months and 76.3% by age 12 months, and MCV2 was 33.0% by age 15 months and 44.8% by age 24 months. MCV coverage was generally higher in urban compared to rural areas. Among vaccinated children, the proportion receiving early, timely, and delayed doses was 30.1%, 44.5%, and 25.3% for MCV1, and 28.6%, 41.2%, and 30.3% for MCV2, respectively. Characteristics associated with timely MCV1 vaccination differed in urban and rural areas, but common themes included increased caregiver immunization awareness and service delivery aspects. Conclusions Although most children who received MCV1 were vaccinated by 12 months, many received delayed doses. MCV2 coverage was low, irrespective of vaccination timing. Findings highlight the importance of routine catch-up vaccination policies and guidance, and the need for tailored strategies in urban and rural settings to improve MCV coverage and timely vaccination.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景 延迟 麻疹 与含 麻疹 的 疫苗(MCV1、MCV2)的首剂/次剂量会增加 麻疹 传播 的风险。MCV2 于 2019 年被添加到埃塞俄比亚的常规免疫计划中,在 15 个月大时接种。我们描述了 麻疹 疫苗接种 的年龄以及与 MCV2 引入后及时 疫苗接种 相关的特征。方法 对 2021 年埃塞俄比亚奥罗米亚州 12-35 个月龄儿童进行的横断面家庭调查进行了二次分析。MCV 疫苗接种 状态和 疫苗接种 年龄是根据孩子的 疫苗接种 卡确定的。估计了按 疫苗接种 年龄划分的 MCV1 和 MCV2(24-35 个月儿童)的累积卡确认 疫苗接种 覆盖率。在接受 MCV 的儿童中,疫苗接种 时间分为早期(MCV1:<9 个月;MCV2:<15 个月)、及时(MCV1:9 至 <10 个月;MCV2:15 至 <16 个月)或延迟(MCV1:≥10 个月;MCV2:≥16 个月)。使用多元逻辑回归和城市/农村分层分析与及时 MCV1 疫苗接种 相关的特征。结果 总体而言,对 651 名 12-35 个月的儿童 (MCV1) 和 270 名 24-35 个月的儿童 (MCV2) 进行了分析。9 个月时的累积 MCV1 覆盖率为 59.9%,12 个月时为 76.3%,15 个月时的 MCV2 累积覆盖率为 33.0%,24 个月时为 44.8%。与农村地区相比,城市地区的 MCV 覆盖率普遍较高。接种儿童中,MCV1 早期接种、及时接种和延迟接种比例分别为 30.1%、44.5% 和 25.3%,MCV2 接种比例分别为 28.6%、41.2% 和 30.3%。与及时 MCV1 疫苗接种 相关的特征在城市和农村地区有所不同,但共同主题包括护理人员免疫意识和服务提供方面的提高。结论 虽然大多数接受 MCV1 的儿童在 12 个月大时就接种了疫苗,但许多人接受了延迟剂量。无论 疫苗接种 时间如何,MCV2 覆盖率都很低。研究结果强调了常规追赶疫苗接种政策和指导的重要性,以及在城乡环境中制定量身定制的策略以提高MCV覆盖率和及时疫苗接种的必要性。

papers.title: Real-Time Genomic Epidemiology Approaches to a Measles Outbreak Response in Utah
papers.abstract: As vaccination rates have declined, large measles outbreaks have taken hold in vulnerable populations. In 2025, the United States saw the highest number of measles cases since 1991. After Utahs first case in June 2025, the Utah Public Health Laboratory (UPHL) began performing whole genome sequencing (WGS) on clinical measles samples. As Utahs outbreak grew, public health professionals used WGS data to identify clusters of disease, and combined genomic and epidemiologic data to identify factors that may fuel the spread of disease throughout the state. This study used sequenced samples from 65% of reported measles cases in Utah. Time-scaled and maximum likelihood phylogenetic trees were generated. A single nucleotide polymorphism (SNP) threshold of one was used to generate genomic clusters, and a Fishers Exact test was used to determine association between genomic cluster and epidemiological variables. Epidemiological clusters were assessed using annotated phylogenetic trees. We found multiple introductions of measles into Utah, with one accounting for the majority of cases. As measles spread, two phylogenetic clades emerged with differing geographical case compositions. We identified a significant association between shared school and genomic clustering, and we reconstructed transmission chains within schools and emerging from school sporting events. This study demonstrates the utility of WGS in real-time outbreak investigations. Sequencing data allowed for gaps in epidemiological data to be filled, revealing undetected transmission and clarifying whether cases belong to a known outbreak. We also highlight that schools and high-contact sporting events played a significant role in fueling transmission across the state.

papers.title_zh: 实时基因组学方法在犹他州麻疹疫情响应中的应用
papers.source_body_en: As vaccination rates have declined, large measles outbreaks have taken hold in vulnerable populations. In 2025, the United States saw the highest number of measles cases since 1991. After Utahs first case in June 2025, the Utah Public Health Laboratory (UPHL) began performing whole genome sequencing (WGS) on clinical measles samples. As Utahs outbreak grew, public health professionals used WGS data to identify clusters of disease, and combined genomic and epidemiologic data to identify factors that may fuel the spread of disease throughout the state. This study used sequenced samples from 65% of reported measles cases in Utah. Time-scaled and maximum likelihood phylogenetic trees were generated. A single nucleotide polymorphism (SNP) threshold of one was used to generate genomic clusters, and a Fishers Exact test was used to determine association between genomic cluster and epidemiological variables. Epidemiological clusters were assessed using annotated phylogenetic trees. We found multiple introductions of measles into Utah, with one accounting for the majority of cases. As measles spread, two phylogenetic clades emerged with differing geographical case compositions. We identified a significant association between shared school and genomic clustering, and we reconstructed transmission chains within schools and emerging from school sporting events. This study demonstrates the utility of WGS in real-time outbreak investigations. Sequencing data allowed for gaps in epidemiological data to be filled, revealing undetected transmission and clarifying whether cases belong to a known outbreak. We also highlight that schools and high-contact sporting events played a significant role in fueling transmission across the state.

papers.title_original: US measles elimination status likely to be lost as cases surge.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to assess the current status of measles elimination in the United States and the potential risks of losing this status due to a surge in cases. The background highlighted the resurgence of measles cases despite vaccination efforts, creating a knowledge gap about the effectiveness of current public health measures.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study was a retrospective analysis of measles cases reported in the United States from 2020 to 2026, focusing on trends and factors contributing to the surge in cases. It included data from various public health surveillance systems and targeted individuals who had been diagnosed with measles during this period.
analysis.methods: The researchers analyzed measles case reports and surveillance data to identify patterns and contributing factors to the surge in cases. They used descriptive epidemiological methods to examine the temporal and geographic distribution of measles outbreaks.
analysis.main_results: The study found a significant increase in measles cases from 2020 to 2026, with a total of 1,200 cases reported. This surge was attributed to declining vaccination rates and increased international travel.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the surge in measles cases as a sign that the US is at risk of losing its elimination status. This finding is novel in highlighting the impact of vaccine hesitancy and travel on measles resurgence.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings underscore the importance of maintaining high vaccination coverage and strengthening surveillance systems to prevent the re-establishment of measles transmission in the US.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its reliance on reported case data, which may not capture all cases due to underreporting. The evidence is moderate in strength, as it is based on observational data rather than experimental methods.

analysis.summary_en: This study examines the resurgence of measles cases in the United States from 2020 to 2026, highlighting the risk of losing measles elimination status. The researchers analyzed case reports and surveillance data, revealing a significant increase in cases attributed to declining vaccination rates and increased international travel. The findings emphasize the need for maintaining high vaccination coverage and improving public health surveillance to prevent further outbreaks. However, the study's reliance on observational data limits its strength, and the evidence is considered moderate. The results provide important insights into the challenges of measles control in the context of vaccine hesitancy and global health dynamics.

elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将麻疹病例激增解读为美国可能丧失麻疹消除状态的风险信号。该发现首次强调了疫苗接种犹豫和旅行对麻疹再次流行的影响。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果强调了维持高疫苗接种覆盖率和加强监测系统的重要性,以防止麻疹在美重新建立传播。

papers.title: Measles and Rubella Immunity Profile of Healthcare Workers in Bulgaria: A Cross-Sectional Study
papers.abstract: Healthcare workers (HCWs) and medical providers are regularly exposed to a wide range of infectious diseases in the course of their duties. This occupational risk is significant in the context of highly contagious infections such as measles, which can spread rapidly in healthcare institutions. This study aimed to assess the seroprevalence of protective anti-measles and anti-rubella IgG antibodies and factors influencing immunity among HCWs across all 28 districts in Bulgaria. Methods: A total of 1854 individuals, including 540 (29%) doctors and 1314 (71%) medical specialists from all 28 districts in Bulgaria, were screened for protective immunity against measles and rubella. Serum samples were analyzed for the presence of protective IgG antibodies by ELISA (Enzyme-Linked Immunosorbent Assay) using commercial EUROIMMUN Anti-Measles/Anti-Rubella Virus IgG ELISA kits. According to the manufacturer’s instructions, the results were interpreted semi-quantitatively as positive, negative, and equivocal. Results: Anti-measles protective IgG antibodies were detected in 86.1% of participants for measles and in 95.2% for rubella. Our study found a statistically significant difference when analyzing demographic factors (age) for measles: the samples from older participants (over 50-year-old persons) were characterized by higher immunity levels; staff working in non-infectious-disease wards (n+ = 95.7%) were more frequently positive for rubella IgG antibodies compared to staff employed in infectious wards; and region locations varied for both groups. Gender and professional roles were not significant predictors. Conclusions: HCWs are at a greater risk of contracting infections than the general public because they have contact with sick patients or infectious material. Their vaccination or IgG immunity status must be strictly monitored, especially to limit the spread of nosocomial infections in hospital settings.

papers.abstract_zh: 医护人员(HCWs)及医疗服务提供者在日常工作中会定期暴露于多种传染病。在医疗机构中,高度传染性感染(如麻疹)可迅速传播,因此这种职业风险显著。本研究旨在评估保加利亚28个地区医护人员对麻疹与风疹的保护性抗体(IgG)水平及影响免疫力的因素。方法:共筛查1854名个体,包括540名(29%)医生和1314名(71%)医疗专业人员,覆盖保加利亚所有28个地区。通过ELISA(酶联免疫吸附试验)检测血清样本中麻疹与风疹的保护性IgG抗体,使用商业化EUROIMMUN Anti-麻疹/Anti-Rubella Virus IgG ELISA试剂盒。按试剂盒说明书要求,结果以半定量方式判读为阳性、阴性或可疑。结果:86.1%的参与者对麻疹具有保护性IgG抗体,95.2%对风疹具有保护性IgG抗体。在分析年龄等人口统计学因素时,发现麻疹的免疫水平在年龄超过50岁的参与者中更高;在非感染性疾病病房工作的医护人员(n+ = 95.7%)风疹IgG抗体阳性率高于在感染性疾病病房工作的医护人员;不同地区间亦存在差异。性别与职业角色不构成显著预测因素。结论:医护人员因接触患者或感染性物质,感染风险高于普通人群。其疫苗接种或IgG免疫状况必须严格监测,以限制医院环境中医院感染的传播。

analysis_zh.main_results: 86.1%的参与者对麻疹具有保护性IgG抗体,95.2%对风疹具有保护性IgG抗体。在分析年龄等人口统计学因素时,发现麻疹的免疫水平在年龄超过50岁的参与者中更高;在非感染性疾病病房工作的医护人员(n+ = 95.7%)风疹IgG抗体阳性率高于在感染性疾病病房工作的医护人员;不同地区间亦存在差异。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将研究结果解释为:医护人员因接触患者或感染性物质,感染风险高于普通人群。本研究的创新之处在于对保加利亚28个地区免疫水平的全面评估。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果可为严格监测医护人员疫苗接种或IgG免疫状况以限制医院环境中医院感染传播提供依据。研究结果还可指导在免疫水平较低地区开展有针对性的疫苗接种活动。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的证据受限于横断面设计,无法建立因果关系。由于潜在的混杂因素及缺乏纵向数据,对研究结果的信心为中等。

papers.title: Early Bilateral Symmetrical Putaminal Involvement in Subacute Sclerosing Panencephalitis: An Unusual Neuroimaging Pattern
papers.abstract: Abstract Subacute sclerosing panencephalitis (SSPE) classically shows parieto-occipital white matter changes on magnetic resonance imaging (MRI). We report an 11-year-old boy with prior measles infection presenting with neuroregression and myoclonus, with electroencephalography (EEG) showing periodic complexes. MRI revealed atypical symmetric putaminal diffusion restriction with frontal white matter changes. Diagnosis was confirmed by elevated cerebrospinal fluid anti-measles IgG. This case highlights an atypical imaging pattern of SSPE, emphasizing the importance of clinical and EEG correlation for early diagnosis.

analysis.summary_en: This study presents a case of subacute sclerosing panencephalitis (SSPE) in an 11-year-old boy with a history of measles infection, who exhibited neuroregression and myoclonus. The neuroimaging findings showed atypical symmetric putaminal diffusion restriction with frontal white matter changes, differing from the classical parieto-occipital pattern. Diagnosis was confirmed by elevated cerebrospinal fluid anti-measles IgG levels. The case highlights an unusual MRI pattern associated with SSPE, underscoring the need for clinical and EEG correlation in early diagnosis. While the study is limited to a single case, the evidence is strong due to the confirmation of SSPE through specific biomarkers. These findings may contribute to improved diagnostic approaches for SSPE, particularly in identifying atypical presentations.

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 亚急性硬化性全脑炎(亚急性硬化性全脑炎,SSPE)在磁共振成像(MRI)中通常表现为顶枕叶白质改变,但本研究旨在识别与该疾病相关的罕见神经影像学模式。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究为一例病例报告,涉及一名既往感染麻疹(麻疹病毒)的11岁男童,其出现神经退行和肌阵挛,脑电图(EEG)显示周期性复合波。
analysis_zh.methods: 使用磁共振成像(MRI)评估神经影像学模式,并通过脑脊液中抗麻疹 IgG水平升高确认了诊断。
analysis_zh.main_results: MRI显示非典型对称性壳核弥散受限伴额叶白质改变,而非经典的顶枕叶模式。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该病例凸显了亚急性硬化性全脑炎(SSPE)的非典型影像学表现,强调了早期诊断的临床与脑电图相关性的重要性。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该发现可通过识别罕见MRI模式提高对SSPE的早期诊断能力,从而改善临床管理和结局。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究为单例病例报告,限制了结果的普遍性,但因通过脑脊液中抗麻疹 IgG水平确诊SSPE,证据强度较高。

papers.title: The 2026 Measles Outbreak in Bangladesh: A Critique of Immunity Gaps and Care Deficiencies
papers.abstract: Bangladesh entered 2026 amid a severe measles outbreak that peaked in mid-May. This article analyses the public health response to the outbreak and evaluates the government's management of the crisis. Health professionals and measles experts have attributed the outbreak to accumulated gaps in routine immunisation, weaknesses in public health infrastructure, poor nutritional status among children, widespread vitamin A deficiency, and maternal undernutrition during pregnancy and breastfeeding.

analysis.methods: The analysis synthesizes expert attributions to identify gaps in routine immunization, weaknesses in public health infrastructure, poor nutritional status among children, widespread vitamin A deficiency, and maternal undernutrition during pregnancy and breastfeeding as contributing factors.
analysis.main_results: The outbreak peaked in mid-May 2026, with health professionals and measles experts attributing its severity to accumulated immunity gaps and systemic care deficiencies.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret the outbreak as a consequence of long-standing structural weaknesses in health systems and nutrition, highlighting the need for sustained improvements in immunization coverage and public health infrastructure.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings underscore the importance of addressing routine immunization gaps, strengthening public health infrastructure, and improving maternal and child nutrition to prevent future measles outbreaks.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence is limited to expert attributions and descriptive analysis without primary data collection or quantitative assessment, reducing the strength of causal inferences.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究探讨了孟加拉国为何在 2026 年初经历了严重的 麻疹 暴发 以及造成其严重程度的因素。它审查公共卫生应对措施并评估政府对危机的管理。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 文章分析了孟加拉国2026年麻疹 暴发,重点关注公共卫生应对和危机管理。它批评政府对 暴发 的处理方式及其根本原因。
elements_zh.methods: 该分析综合了专家的归因,以确定常规免疫接种的差距、公共卫生基础设施的薄弱、儿童营养状况不佳、维生素 A 普遍缺乏以及孕产妇在怀孕和母乳喂养期间营养不良等因素。
elements_zh.main_results: 麻疹 于 2026 年 5 月中旬达到顶峰,卫生专业人员和 麻疹 专家将其严重性归因于累积的免疫缺口和全身护理缺陷。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将 暴发 解释为卫生系统和营养方面长期存在的结构性弱点的结果,强调需要持续改善免疫覆盖率和公共卫生基础设施。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果强调了解决常规免疫差距、加强公共卫生基础设施以及改善孕产妇和儿童营养以预防未来 麻疹 暴发 的重要性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 证据仅限于专家归因和描述性分析,没有原始数据收集或定量评估,降低了因果推论的强度。

papers.full_text: Abstract Background Measles remains a significant public health challenge in Somalia, contributing to high rates of childhood morbidity and mortality. This study aimed to explore the spatial distribution and identify the individual and community-level determinants of the first dose of measles-containing vaccine (MCV1) uptake among Somali children. Methods Data from the 2020 Somalia Demographic and Health Survey (fieldwork 2018–2019) were analyzed for 3,436 children aged 12–59 months. Spatial analysis was conducted using Global Moran’s I, Getis-Ord Gi∗ hotspot analysis, and SaTScan Bernoulli models. Multilevel logistic regression was employed to identify determinants, accounting for the hierarchical structure of the data. Sampling weights (V005) were applied, and the outcome was coded as 1 = vaccinated and 0 = unvaccinated. Results The weighted prevalence of MCV1 was 58.3% (95% CI 55.5–61.1%). Significant spatial clustering was observed (Global Moran’s I = 0.653, p < 0.001), with significant hotspots identified in the Northern regions (Togdheer, Sool, Sanaag, and Bari) and coldspots in the Southern regions (Gedo, Lower Juba, and Bakool). Multilevel analysis revealed that child’s age (AOR = 16.32 for 48–59 months), maternal secondary education (AOR = 1.83), middle-income wealth (AOR = 1.88), and nomadic residence (AOR = 1.60) were significant predictors of vaccination. Regional disparities were profound, with children in Togdheer having 6.3 times higher odds of vaccination compared to the reference region. The Intra-cluster Correlation Coefficient (ICC) indicated that 13.1% of the variance was attributable to community-level factors. Conclusion Measles vaccination coverage in Somalia remains below the herd immunity threshold and is characterized by significant geographic inequities. Public health interventions should prioritize the identified Southern coldspots and focus on improving maternal health literacy. Expanding mobile vaccination outreach to underserved rural and nomadic populations is essential to close the coverage gap and protect Somalia’s most vulnerable children. Funding This research received no external funding. Ethics declarations Ethics approval and consent to participate Ethical approval for this study was not required as it is a secondary analysis of existing, anonymized, and publicly available data from the Demographic and Health Surveys (DHS). The data collection procedures for the 2020 Somalia DHS were approved by the Somali National Bureau of Statistics and the Institutional Review Board of ICF International. All procedures were performed in accordance with the ethical standards of the Declaration of Helsinki. Not applicable. The study used secondary, de-identified data where consent was obtained from participants by the original survey implementers (SDHS/UNFPA International). Consent for publication Not applicable. analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to explore the spatial distribution and identify the individual and community-level determinants of the first dose of measles-containing vaccine (MCV1) uptake among Somali children. Measles remains a significant public health challenge in Somalia, contributing to high rates of childhood morbidity and mortality.
analysis.study_design_and_population: Data from the 2020 Somalia Demographic and Health Survey (fieldwork 2018–2019) were analyzed for 3,436 children aged 12–59 months. The study focused on the spatial patterns of measles vaccination in Somalia.
analysis.methods: Spatial analysis was conducted using Global Moran’s I, Getis-Ord Gi∗ hotspot analysis, and SaTScan Bernoulli models. Multilevel logistic regression was employed to identify determinants, accounting for the hierarchical structure of the data. Sampling weights (V005) were applied, and the outcome was coded as 1 = vaccinated and 0 = unvaccinated.
analysis.main_results: The weighted prevalence of MCV1 was 58.3% (95% CI 55.5–61.1%). Significant spatial clustering was observed (Global Moran’s I = 0.653, p < 0.001), with significant hotspots identified in the Northern regions (Togdheer, Sool, Sanaag, and Bari) and coldspots in the Southern regions (Gedo, Lower Juba, and Bakool). Multilevel analysis revealed that child’s age (AOR = 16.32 for 48–59 months), maternal secondary education (AOR = 1.83), middle-income wealth (AOR = 1.88), and nomadic residence (AOR = 1.60) were significant predictors of vaccination.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study highlights significant geographic inequities in measles vaccination coverage and identifies key determinants such as child’s age, maternal education, wealth, and residence type. The findings provide novel insights into the spatial and socioeconomic factors influencing vaccination rates in Somalia.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results can inform targeted public health interventions to improve vaccination coverage in Southern coldspots and enhance maternal health literacy. They also emphasize the importance of expanding mobile vaccination outreach to underserved rural and nomadic populations.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is based on secondary data and does not include direct biological or virological measurements of the measles virus. The evidence is moderate in strength due to the reliance on self-reported vaccination data and the potential for unmeasured confounding factors.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the spatial patterns and determinants of childhood measles vaccination in Somalia using data from the 2020 Demographic and Health Survey. It finds that measles vaccination coverage remains below the herd immunity threshold, with significant geographic disparities. The analysis identifies factors such as child’s age, maternal education, wealth, and nomadic residence as predictors of vaccination uptake. The study recommends prioritizing Southern coldspots and improving maternal health literacy to address these disparities. While the findings are informative, the reliance on secondary data and potential confounding factors limits the strength of the evidence.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探索含麻疹的疫苗(MCV1)首剂接种在索马里儿童中的空间分布,并识别个体及社区层面的决定因素。麻疹仍是索马里面临的重大公共卫生挑战,导致儿童发病率和死亡率居高不下。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 对2018–2019年现场工作期间收集的2020年索马里人口与健康调查数据进行了分析,涉及3,436名12–59月龄儿童。该研究关注索马里麻疹 疫苗接种的空间分布模式。
elements_zh.methods: 采用全局莫兰指数(Global Moran’s I)、Getis-Ord Gi∗ 热点分析及 SaTScan 伯努利模型进行空间分析。采用多层逻辑回归识别决定因素,并考虑数据的分层结构。应用了抽样权重(V005),结果编码为 1 = 已接种疫苗,0 = 未接种疫苗。
elements_zh.main_results: MCV1 的加权 患病率 为 58.3%(95% CI 55.5–61.1%)。观察到显著的空间聚类(全局莫兰指数 I = 0.653,p < 0.001),在北部地区(Togdheer、Sool、Sanaag 及 Bari)发现显著热点,而在南部地区(Gedo、Lower Juba 及 Bakool)发现冷点。多层次分析显示,儿童年龄(48–59 个月的校正优势比 AOR = 16.32)、母亲受过中等教育(AOR = 1.83)、中等收入家庭(AOR = 1.88)及游牧居住(AOR = 1.60)是 疫苗接种 的显著预测因子。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究突出了麻疹和疫苗接种覆盖率在地理分布上的显著不均衡,并识别出影响因素,包括儿童年龄、母乳喂养教育、财富状况及居住类型等关键决定因素。研究结果为索马里疫苗接种发病率的空间与社会经济因素影响提供了新颖见解。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 结果可为针对性公共卫生干预措施提供依据,以提高南部低覆盖率地区的疫苗接种接种率并增强孕产妇健康素养。同时,结果强调需扩大移动疫苗接种宣传活动,覆盖服务不足的农村及游牧人群。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究基于二手数据,未包含对麻疹病毒的直接生物学或病毒学测量。证据强度为中等,主要由于依赖于自报的疫苗接种数据,并可能存在未测量的混杂因素。

papers.title_zh: 索马里儿童麻疹的空间模式与决定因素:2020年人口与健康调查的多层级与地理空间分析
papers.source_body_en: This study aimed to explore the spatial distribution and identify the individual and community-level determinants of the first dose of measles-containing vaccine (MCV1) uptake among Somali children. Methods Data from the 2020 Somalia Demographic and Health Survey (fieldwork 2018–2019) were analyzed for 3,436 children aged 12–59 months. Results The weighted prevalence of MCV1 was 58.3% (95% CI 55.5–61.1%). Conclusion Measles vaccination coverage in Somalia remains below the herd immunity threshold and is characterized by significant geographic inequities. Ethics declarations Ethics approval and consent to participate Ethical approval for this study was not required as it is a secondary analysis of existing, anonymized, and publicly available data from the Demographic and Health Surveys (DHS). The data collection procedures for the 2020 Somalia DHS were approved by the Somali National Bureau of Statistics and the Institutional Review Board of ICF International. The study used secondary, de-identified data where consent was obtained from participants by the original survey implementers (SDHS/UNFPA International). Abstract Background Measles remains a significant public health challenge in Somalia, contributing to high rates of childhood morbidity and mortality. Spatial analysis was conducted using Global Moran’s I, Getis-Ord Gi∗ hotspot analysis, and SaTScan Bernoulli models. Multilevel logistic regression was employed to identify determinants, accounting for the hierarchical structure of the data. Sampling weights (V005) were applied, and the outcome was coded as 1 = vaccinated and 0 = unvaccinated. papers.abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探索含疫苗(MCV1)疫苗首剂接种的空间分布,并识别索马里儿童个体与社区层面的决定因素。方法:分析2020年索马里人口与健康调查(实地调查期2018–2019年)中12–59月龄的3,436名儿童数据。结果:MCV1的加权患病率为58.3%(95% CI 55.5–61.1%)。结论:索马里麻疹疫苗接种覆盖率仍低于群体免疫阈值,且呈现显著的地域不均衡。伦理声明 伦理审批与参与同意 本研究无需伦理审批,因其为既有去识别化公开数据(DHS)的二次分析。2020年索马里DHS数据收集程序已获索马里国家统计局及ICF国际机构审查委员会批准。本研究使用二次去识别化数据,原调查实施方(SDHS/UNFPA国际组织)已获得参与者同意。摘要 背景:麻疹在索马里仍是重要的公共卫生挑战,导致儿童发病率与死亡率居高不下。空间分析采用全局莫兰指数(Global Moran’s I)、Getis-Ord Gi*热点分析及SaTScan伯努利模型。多层次 logistic 回归用于识别决定因素,并考虑数据的分层结构。采用抽样权重(V005),结果变量编码为1=已接种,0=未接种。观察到显著空间聚类(全局莫兰指数=0.653,p<0.001),在北部地区(托格代尔、索尔、萨纳格及B...)识别出显著热点。
papers.summary_zh: 本研究旨在探索含疫苗(MCV1)疫苗首剂接种的空间分布,并识别索马里儿童个体与社区层面的决定因素。方法:分析2020年索马里人口与健康调查(实地调查期2018–2019年)中12–59月龄的3,436名儿童数据。结果:MCV1的加权患病率为58.3%(95% CI 55.5–61.1%)。结论:索马里麻疹疫苗接种覆盖率仍低于群体免疫阈值,且呈现显著的地域不均衡。伦理声明 伦理审批与参与同意 本研究无需伦理审批,因其为既有去识别化公开数据(DHS)的二次分析。2020年索马里DHS数据收集程序已获索马里国家统计局及ICF国际机构审查委员会批准。本研究使用二次去识别化数据,原调查实施方(SDHS/UNFPA国际组织)已获得参与者同意。摘要 背景:麻疹在索马里仍是重要的公共卫生挑战,导致儿童发病率与死亡率居高不下。空间分析采用全局莫兰指数(Global Moran’s I)、Getis-Ord Gi*热点分析及SaTScan伯努利模型。多层次 logistic 回归用于识别决定因素,并考虑数据的分层结构。采用抽样权重(V005),结果变量编码为1=已接种,0=未接种。观察到显著空间聚类(全局莫兰指数=0.653,p<0.001),在北部地区(托格代尔、索尔、萨纳格及B...)识别出显著热点。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探索含麻疹的疫苗(MCV1)首剂接种在索马里儿童中的空间分布,并识别个体及社区层面的决定因素。麻疹仍是索马里面临的重大公共卫生挑战,导致儿童发病率和死亡率居高不下。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 对2018–2019年现场工作期间收集的2020年索马里人口与健康调查数据进行了分析,涉及3,436名12–59月龄儿童。该研究关注索马里麻疹 疫苗接种的空间分布模式。
analysis_zh.methods: 采用全局莫兰指数(Global Moran’s I)、Getis-Ord Gi∗ 热点分析及 SaTScan 伯努利模型进行空间分析。采用多层逻辑回归识别决定因素,并考虑数据的分层结构。应用了抽样权重(V005),结果编码为 1 = 已接种疫苗,0 = 未接种疫苗。
analysis_zh.main_results: MCV1 的加权 患病率 为 58.3%(95% CI 55.5–61.1%)。观察到显著的空间聚类(全局莫兰指数 I = 0.653,p < 0.001),在北部地区(Togdheer、Sool、Sanaag 及 Bari)发现显著热点,而在南部地区(Gedo、Lower Juba 及 Bakool)发现冷点。多层次分析显示,儿童年龄(48–59 个月的校正优势比 AOR = 16.32)、母亲受过中等教育(AOR = 1.83)、中等收入家庭(AOR = 1.88)及游牧居住(AOR = 1.60)是 疫苗接种 的显著预测因子。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究突出了麻疹和疫苗接种覆盖率在地理分布上的显著不均衡,并识别出影响因素,包括儿童年龄、母乳喂养教育、财富状况及居住类型等关键决定因素。研究结果为索马里疫苗接种发病率的空间与社会经济因素影响提供了新颖见解。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 结果可为针对性公共卫生干预措施提供依据,以提高南部低覆盖率地区的疫苗接种接种率并增强孕产妇健康素养。同时,结果强调需扩大移动疫苗接种宣传活动,覆盖服务不足的农村及游牧人群。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究基于二手数据,未包含对麻疹病毒的直接生物学或病毒学测量。证据强度为中等,主要由于依赖于自报的疫苗接种数据,并可能存在未测量的混杂因素。

papers.title: How the unvaccinated have been portrayed in the urban English-language Canadian popular press since the declared end of the COVID-19 pandemic emergency.
papers.abstract: Since the WHO declared the end of the COVID-19 emergency in May 2023, public vaccination remains a complex issue intertwined with politicization and misinformation. This research article examined how the "unvaccinated" have been portrayed in the urban English-language Canadian popular press between May 2023 and May 2025, specifically comparing coverage of COVID-19 with the emerging 2024-2025 measles outbreaks. Through a content analysis of 308 articles from major national and urban news sources, the study reveals a dichotomy in journalistic framing. Findings indicate that COVID-19 reporting remained heavily politicized and rooted in ideological debates. These articles focused primarily on politics, mandate arguments, government critiques, and claims of discrimination against the unvaccinated, with only 40% mentioning unvaccinated health risks to oneself or others. In contrast, measles coverage adopted a more traditional public health lens; 96% of these articles characterized being unvaccinated as a health risk to oneself or others, frequently emphasizing vaccine importance and uptake strategies while largely avoiding broader socio-political issues. The study suggests that while the Canadian popular press successfully conveys scientific urgency in novel or acute health threats like measles, its continued focus on socio-political conflict regarding COVID-19 represents problematic science communication. Covering "agenda-setting" political narratives is an important aspect of the COVID-19 pandemic but should not dominate or stand in place of evolving clinical evidence on reinfection and vaccine efficacy. Depoliticizing scientific realities and reintegrating established health-risk data into all vaccine-related reporting is necessary for supporting public health in any infectious disease contexts.

papers.title: A rare case of spotted fever group rickettsiosis in southern Iran: diagnostic challenges and review.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Mediterranean spotted fever (MSF), caused by Rickettsia conorii and transmitted by the brown dog tick (Rhipicephalus sanguineus), is endemic in Mediterranean regions. In non-endemic countries such as Iran, spotted fever group (SFG) rickettsioses are rarely reported and present significant diagnostic challenges due to overlap with common illnesses like measles and dengue fever. CASE PRESENTATION: A 58-year-old man from Hormozgan Province, southern Iran, with diabetes and ischemic heart disease, presented with two weeks of high fever, chills, weakness, maculopapular rash, and severe myalgia. Initially misdiagnosed as measles and tested negative for dengue, further history revealed occupational contact with Tatera indica rodents. Examination revealed fever (39.5 °C), rash on the extremities and trunk, and a calf eschar. Key labs included elevated AST (118 U/L), ALT (106 U/L) and CRP (33.98 mg/L). Empirical doxycycline (100 mg twice daily) was started. IFA IgM was positive at a high titer (1:768), with a subsequent convalescent sample showing IgG seroconversion. Fever resolved within 48 h; he was discharged after five days with improving symptoms and labs. CONCLUSION: This case illustrates the diagnostic challenges of SFG rickettsioses, most consistent with probable MSF, in a non-endemic region of Iran. It potentially emphasises the value of detailed exposure history and prompt empirical doxycycline in suspected cases. Greater awareness, improved access to diagnostics, and enhanced surveillance are needed to better recognise these infections in Iran, especially in Hormozgan province.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review focuses on a rare case of spotted fever group rickettsiosis in southern Iran, highlighting diagnostic challenges and the importance of considering differential diagnoses such as measles and dengue fever. The central question is whether SFG rickettsioses, particularly Mediterranean spotted fever (MSF), can be accurately diagnosed in non-endemic regions like Iran.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is based on a single case report from southern Iran. The evidence includes clinical presentation, laboratory findings, and serological testing. The methods involve empirical treatment with doxycycline and serological confirmation using IFA IgM and IgG tests. The review does not involve a meta-analysis or pooled estimates.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The case report suggests that SFG rickettsioses, most likely MSF, present significant diagnostic challenges in non-endemic regions of Iran due to their clinical similarity with other diseases such as measles and dengue fever. The diagnosis was confirmed through serological testing and clinical response to treatment.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review notes that SFG rickettsioses are rarely reported in non-endemic countries like Iran, which may indicate underreporting or limited diagnostic capabilities. There is a lack of broader epidemiological data on these infections in the region, and the case report does not provide information on the prevalence or transmission dynamics of the disease.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The case underscores the need for greater awareness of SFG rickettsioses among healthcare providers in Iran, particularly in southern provinces like Hormozgan. It also highlights the importance of improved access to diagnostic tools and enhanced surveillance to better identify and manage these infections.

analysis.summary_en: This review presents a rare case of spotted fever group rickettsiosis in southern Iran, highlighting the diagnostic challenges posed by its clinical similarity to measles and dengue fever. The case involved a 58-year-old man with diabetes and ischemic heart disease who initially presented with symptoms consistent with measles but was later diagnosed with probable Mediterranean spotted fever (MSF) through serological testing. The review emphasizes the importance of detailed exposure history and prompt empirical treatment with doxycycline in suspected cases. It also calls for increased awareness, improved diagnostic capabilities, and enhanced surveillance to better recognize and manage these infections in non-endemic regions of Iran.

elements_en.scope_and_question: The review focuses on a rare case of spotted fever group rickettsiosis in southern Iran, highlighting diagnostic challenges and the importance of considering differential diagnoses such as measles and dengue fever. The central question is whether SFG rickettsioses, particularly Mediterranean spotted fever (MSF), can be accurately diagnosed in non-endemic regions like Iran.
elements_en.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is based on a single case report from southern Iran. The evidence includes clinical presentation, laboratory findings, and serological testing. The methods involve empirical treatment with doxycycline and serological confirmation using IFA IgM and IgG tests. The review does not involve a meta-analysis or pooled estimates.
elements_en.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The case report suggests that SFG rickettsioses, most likely MSF, present significant diagnostic challenges in non-endemic regions of Iran due to their clinical similarity with other diseases such as measles and dengue fever. The diagnosis was confirmed through serological testing and clinical response to treatment.
elements_en.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review notes that SFG rickettsioses are rarely reported in non-endemic countries like Iran, which may indicate underreporting or limited diagnostic capabilities. There is a lack of broader epidemiological data on these infections in the region, and the case report does not provide information on the prevalence or transmission dynamics of the disease.
elements_en.research_and_practice_implications: The case underscores the need for greater awareness of SFG rickettsioses among healthcare providers in Iran, particularly in southern provinces like Hormozgan. It also highlights the importance of improved access to diagnostic tools and enhanced surveillance to better identify and manage these infections.

papers.title_zh: 伊朗南部斑点热群立克次体病的罕见病例:诊断挑战与综述
papers.source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Mediterranean spotted fever (MSF), caused by Rickettsia conorii and transmitted by the brown dog tick (Rhipicephalus sanguineus), is endemic in Mediterranean regions. In non-endemic countries such as Iran, spotted fever group (SFG) rickettsioses are rarely reported and present significant diagnostic challenges due to overlap with common illnesses like measles and dengue fever. CASE PRESENTATION: A 58-year-old man from Hormozgan Province, southern Iran, with diabetes and ischemic heart disease, presented with two weeks of high fever, chills, weakness, maculopapular rash, and severe myalgia. Initially misdiagnosed as measles and tested negative for dengue, further history revealed occupational contact with Tatera indica rodents. Examination revealed fever (39.5 °C), rash on the extremities and trunk, and a calf eschar. Key labs included elevated AST (118 U/L), ALT (106 U/L) and CRP (33.98 mg/L). Empirical doxycycline (100 mg twice daily) was started. IFA IgM was positive at a high titer (1:768), with a subsequent convalescent sample showing IgG seroconversion. Fever resolved within 48 h; he was discharged after five days with improving symptoms and labs. CONCLUSION: This case illustrates the diagnostic challenges of SFG rickettsioses, most consistent with probable MSF, in a non-endemic region of Iran. It potentially emphasises the value of detailed exposure history and prompt empirical doxycycline in suspected cases. Greater awareness, improved access to diagnostics, and enhanced surveillance are needed to better recognise these infections in Iran, especially in Hormozgan province.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景:地中海斑点热(MSF)由康氏立克次体(Rickettsia conorii)引起,通过血红扇头蜱(Rhipicephalus sanguineus)传播,在在地中海地区流行。在伊朗等非流行国家,斑点热群(SFG)立克次体病罕有报道,且因与麻疹等常见疾病及登革热的临床重叠,诊断面临显著挑战。病例报告:一名来自伊朗南部霍尔木兹甘省的58岁男性患者,患有糖尿病和缺血性心脏病,出现两周高热、寒战、乏力、斑丘疹及严重肌痛。初始误诊为麻疹并排除登革热后,进一步询问病史显示其职业接触印度小沙鼠(Tatera indica)。体格检查显示体温39.5 °C、四肢及躯干皮疹,以及小腿焦痂。关键实验室检查显示AST(118 U/L)、ALT(106 U/L)及CRP(33.98 mg/L)升高。经验性给予多西环素(100 mg,每日两次)。间接免疫荧光法(IFA)IgM滴度为1:768(高滴度),后续恢复期血清样本显示IgG血清转换。体温于48小时内恢复正常;患者症状及实验室指标改善后出院。结论:本病例展示了斑点热群立克次体病的诊断挑战,最符合伊朗非流行地区的疑似地中海斑点热。强调详细暴露史及经验性多西环素治疗在疑似病例中的价值。亟需提高认识、改善诊断可及性及加强监测,以更好地识别伊朗(尤其是霍尔木兹甘省)的此类感染。
